title: pivot and melt: the wide format and the long one

videos.script: Here are twenty-four numbers. Trips per month, for each of two plans. {{numbers}} You can write them as twenty-four rows. A month, a plan, a count. {{long}} Or as twelve rows of two columns, one column per plan. {{wide}} The first is long. The second is wide. Same numbers. {{same}} A person reads the wide one. A groupby, a merge and a chart want the long one. {{who}} So a lot of work in pandas is moving a table between the two. {{moving}} This lesson does it with pivot and melt, and builds the grid every report has. Weekdays down the side, hours across the top. {{grid}} And it looks at the cells that were never there. A grid has to draw every combination, even the ones that never happened. What goes in them is your decision. {{end}}
